"use client";

import { Button, Group, Text } from '@mantine/core';

function Demo() {
  return (
    <>
      <Text size="sm" mb={5} fw={500}>
        Filled variant
      </Text>
      <Group>
        <Button color="cyan">Theme color</Button>
        <Button color="#1D72FE">Hex color</Button>
      </Group>

      <Text size="sm" mb={5} mt="md" fw={500}>
        Light variant
      </Text>
      <Group>
        <Button variant="light" color="cyan">
          Theme color
        </Button>
        <Button variant="light" color="#1D72FE">
          Hex color
        </Button>
      </Group>

      <Text size="sm" mb={5} mt="md" fw={500}>
        Outline variant
      </Text>
      <Group>
        <Button variant="outline" color="cyan">
          Theme color
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" color="#1D72FE">
          Hex color
        </Button>
      </Group>
    </>
  );
}
const RendynExampleComponent = Demo;
export function RendynExample() { return <RendynExampleComponent  />; }

documentation:
# Mantine Theming

Configure or demonstrate shared interface theme values.

## Installation

- Complete MIT usage examples extracted from the upstream demo code template; documentation configurator machinery is excluded.
- Mount MantineProvider once at your client application root and import @mantine/core/styles.css. The returned preview wrapper is a standalone example; reuse an existing provider when integrating.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
